title: When it comes to remaking a game for a different system with chatgpt, should I always use Astra medium or use lower effort or different model for different use cases to optimize rate limits?
author: mattyjoe0706
selftext:
So I'm a Mario fanboy and I've never played new super Mario Bros Wii and I don't have a Wii so I was like you know I could play it on an emulator but I also paid $20 to try out Astra so let me put that money to good use to play it on my modded 3ds and it's actually going really well! The only thing that sucks is that the rate limits go soooo fast. I get it because it's powerful but I wonder if I can go from medium to low for certain things or even use different models. 

I'm a straight vibe coder so I don't really know this stuff well when people use programming terms lol.

comments.author: TartNo3610
comments.body: Astra low is better than sol on high or something like that. They tweeted the comparison.
